neighbours.label: The chunk "ass" when the tokenizer cuts it off as its own piece: after a hyphen in compounds (Steam-Assisted, Quality-Assurance, power-assisted, self-assessment, lane-assist, character-assassination), at the start of names like Assam and Assassin's Creed, and the standalone word for a donkey. Quiet for ordinary whole words that merely contain the letters (assist, assess, assets, assignment, Assembly, class, glass, embassy, Massachusetts, unhyphenated "Quality Assurance") and for hyphen splits that give "-as" (machine-assembled). Weak (about 0.3-0.4) on short words ending in -ass (grass, bass, brass).
neighbours.short: the chunk "ass" split off as its own token
fire: The game uses Steam-Assisted gravity drilling to reach the lower levels.
She works in the Quality-Assurance department at a software firm.
My old bike had power-assisted brakes that squeaked constantly.
Fill out the self-assessment form before your annual review.
The new car's lane-assist feature nudged the wheel back gently.
The senator called the article a character-assassination piece.
We bought a tin of loose-leaf tea grown in Assam.
He spent the whole weekend playing Assassin's Creed.
quiet: The game uses steam pressure to help drilling reach the lower levels.
She works in Quality Assurance at a software firm.
My old bike had brakes that I could assist with a lever.
Teachers will assess each student's work before the annual review.
The new car's steering feature nudged the wheel back gently.
The senator called the article an unfair attack on his reputation.
We bought a tin of loose-leaf tea grown in Darjeeling.
He spent the whole weekend playing a pirate adventure game.

predictions: 8/8 fire above 0.3; near misses under 0.25 (unhyphenated Quality Assurance and assist about 0.2 are the risk)
